"As a toad bides time in a serene glade, I teach patience, let frail grips fade, and promise gifts to those who've stayed." Serene Glade Riddle · Toadgod · Epoch 0

Move with WASD / arrows or your thumb (drag anywhere). Your zap is automatic. Hordes of Faders, FUD and the imitators come to fade you.
Hold steady — patience fills for the frog who doesn't panic. When the clock hits zero, it resets: that is the intra timer reset, and you return stronger. Collect the taboshi yield 🍸. Study frog life. frfr.
The clock resets and the lore lands change — seven zones, each level one zone, each zone one lesson from the word of toadgod. The giants turn their gaze past level VIII.
Now and then the open faucet ⛲ drops a taboshi seed on the field — claim it and your zaps surge. And listen: the toadgod speaks while you fight. The game is the lore, the lore is the game.
